glugluglug is a wine cellar you can keep with your friends.

Free, and it stays on your phone: make a place for bottles — a wine fridge, a shelf, a box in the hallway — and put wine in it. See everything you have at a glance, drink one, and watch the rack empty. No account, no sign-up, no nagging.

THE NOTEBOOK
Not every bottle goes in the cellar. Some you drink at a bar and want to remember. Write it down: give it a verdict from "nope" to "again!!", then pick what it looked, smelled and tasted like from a proper tasting vocabulary — or just say "went great with the pizza" and move on. Over time, the notebook works out what you actually go for.

EVERY BOTTLE, FINDABLE
One searchable list across every place you keep wine. Producer, grape, region, vintage — find the thing you know you have somewhere.

FRIENDS, FREE
An account costs nothing and adds friends, so someone can share a bottle with you the day they hear about this. What they share turns up in your app straight away.

GLUG PLUS
Sharing back, and everything that needs a server, is the subscription:

• Sharing — split a case with a friend, half a bottle each if you like, and the count stays right without a spreadsheet or an awkward conversation
• Shared places — the fridge you keep with the person you live with, visible to you both
• Sync — your cellar on every phone, backed up
• The label scanner — point the camera at a bottle, or pick a photo you already took, and get the wine

Free keeps working. Your cellar just stays on this phone.

WHAT IT DOESN'T DO
No adverts. No analytics. No scores out of 100 from someone who isn't you. Your cellar is yours, and you can export it as a spreadsheet whenever you like.

GLUG PLUS, THE SUBSCRIPTION
glug plus is an auto-renewing monthly subscription. It renews each month unless you switch it off at least 24 hours before the month is up, and you can cancel any time in your App Store settings. The free app keeps working either way.
